summary: Frontend-only test of password match validation on /inscricao.html. Verified 3 scenarios via Playwright with all required fields filled (NOME, CPF válido, DATA_NASCIMENTO, SEXO, CELULAR, EMAIL, CEP com autofill, NUMERO, LOGRADOURO, BAIRRO, CIDADE, UF, DOC_TIPO, DOC_FRENTE, DOC_VERSO, declaracao). All three password-match scenarios passed.
critical_code_review_comments: validateForm() correctly compares SENHA and SENHA_CONFIRM; empty confirm invalidates form; mismatch shows SENHA_ERR; equal values hide it. Implementation is idiomatic and event-bound to input/change of all form fields.
seed_data_creation: None (temporary PNG files created in /tmp/uploads for DOC_FRENTE and DOC_VERSO uploads)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password match validation working correctly on /inscricao.html. Test 1 (senhas '123123'/'12312'): SENHA_ERR display=block AND btn-salvar.disabled=true -> PASS. Test 2 (both '123123' + all other required fields valid): SENHA_ERR display=none AND btn-salvar.disabled=false (enabled) -> PASS. Test 3 (SENHA_CONFIRM vazio): btn-salvar.disabled=true -> PASS. Note: nome field has no #NOME id, use input[name='NOME']. SEXO select has no id, use select[name='SEXO']. Endereço field id is LOGRADOURO not ENDERECO. DOC_TIPO must be selected before DOC_FRENTE/VERSO are visible.
